reason: Research was thin: one WebSearch on VZ found no confirmed October catalyst beyond VZ earnings expected around Oct 20 (unverified estimate) and a ~8.6% drop over September; otherwise this rests on the packet. The book is +4.1% with MO/BTI/PFE gaining and VZ/C down ~9-10% but well inside their 18-20% stops. The semiconductor-led selloff does not touch these defensive, low-multiple dividend payers, and 32% cash earning 4% already provides ballast. Selling VZ or C into weakness just before earnings would pay frictions and crystallise losses on cheap, durable-dividend names with no new information against the thesis, so holding beats trading.
